ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First, the image shows a transition-state complex with a left carbon fragment attached to R, R1, and O; an Al center bridged by oxygens; and a right acyl fragment CH3-C(=O)-CF3. Ignoring the curved arrows and excluding all H-involving bonds, count the heavy-atom bond orders: left carbon to R, R1, and O = 3; O-Al and carbonyl O-Al = 2; right carbonyl C=O = 2; carbonyl C-CH3 = 1; carbonyl C-CF3 = 1; and the CF3 group contributes 3 C-F bonds. Summing gives 3 + 2 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 3 = 12.

method.method_draft: Build a weighted heavy-atom graph from the drawing. The non-H edges are: stereocenter–R, stereocenter–R1, stereocenter–O, O–Al, Al–carbonyl O, carbonyl O=carbonyl C with weight 2, carbonyl C–CH3 carbon, carbonyl C–CF3 carbon, and three CF3 C–F edges. Add the weights: 1+1+1+1+1+2+1+1+3 = 12.
